description: This file defines interface functions and macros for MDIO (Management Data Input/Output) operations specific to the RT2880 chipset in the Ralink/MediaTek device driver. It includes function prototypes for linking, reading, writing MDIO, and port initialization.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_link_adjust
methods.description: Adjusts link settings for a specific port using private device data.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_read
methods.description: Reads a value from a specified MDIO register for a PHY at given address.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_write
methods.description: Writes a value to a specified MDIO register for a PHY at given address.

methods.name: rt2880_port_init
methods.description: Initializes port settings for the device using device tree node.
